images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole solar plant visible inside the frame.
images.detail: Concentric rings of tilted polished mirrors surround the tower and all face toward its top.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, open to the sky, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
images.subject: A solar power plant built around one colossal central tower with a brilliantly glowing receiver at its top. In the bottom right corner of the frame, on the plateau outside the mirror field, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a massive high-voltage electrical substation with giant transformers and crackling blue-white electric arcs, from which a line of colossal steel transmission pylons runs away across the plateau.

images.subject: A solar power plant built around one colossal central tower with a brilliantly glowing receiver at its top. In the bottom right corner of the frame, on the plateau outside the mirror field, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a massive high-voltage electrical substation with giant transformers and crackling blue-white electric arcs, from which a line of colossal steel transmission pylons runs away across the plateau.
